The Genetic Nightmare: Losing Sleep Until Death

Imagine a rare genetic disease that progressively strips away your ability to sleep, leading to terrifying paranoia, vivid hallucinations, and ultimately, a swift, irreversible decline to death. Discover the chilling truth of Fatal Familial Insomnia, revealing sleep's ultimate importance. 🤯😴 Could you ever truly comprehend life without sleep?
